topic: How to automate LinkedIn lead generation and posting with Claude Code (Apollo + HubSpot + Publora via MCP)

claims.claim: Claude Code can add MCP servers with `claude mcp add`, and the in-session `/mcp` command shows server status and handles OAuth sign-in.
quotes: To verify the connection, run `/mcp` and check that the server's row shows a checkmark.
Use `/mcp` to authenticate with remote servers that require OAuth 2.0 authentication

sources.title: Connect Claude Code to tools via MCP

claims.notes: Verified on the official Anthropic docs page. No publish date shown on the page.

claims.claim: Apollo.io has an official, first-party remote MCP server (https://mcp.apollo.io/mcp) that can search Apollo's people database.
quotes: Official, first-party server built and maintained by Apollo.io.
search Apollo's people database by title, seniority, location, and company attributes
claude mcp add --transport http apollo https://mcp.apollo.io/mcp
claims.notes: Verified from Apollo's own GitHub org. The README also lists apollo_mixed_people_api_search, apollo_contacts_create, enrichment and sequence tools, and says 'some actions consume credits'. Plan requirements are NOT stated there; one third-party guide says paid plans/beta, which I could not confirm on an apollo.io page (docs.apollo.io did not come up in searches). Auth is via Apollo OAuth.

claims.claim: HubSpot's official remote MCP server (https://mcp.hubspot.com) is generally available and can create/update contacts and activities, including tasks.
quotes: The remote HubSpot MCP server is graduating from beta and is now generally available to all HubSpot accounts.

sources.title: Remote HubSpot MCP server is now generally available

claims.notes: The changelog lists create/update for CRM records (contacts, companies, deals, tickets, line items, products) and activities (calls, meetings, notes, tasks, emails). Caveats: requires OAuth 2.1 + PKCE through an MCP auth app; actions follow the user's HubSpot permissions; if sensitive data is turned on in the account, activities (including tasks) are blocked from MCP; marketing and content objects are read-only. CONFLICT: the developers.hubspot.com/mcp landing page still has text calling the remote server read-only and mentions 'read scopes'. The changelog is newer and was corrected specifically on read/write, so I treat it as authoritative. Separate local 'Developer MCP server' (hs mcp setup) is for building apps, not CRM data.

claims.claim: Publora offers an official remote MCP server (https://mcp.publora.com/mcp) that can schedule posts to LinkedIn.
quotes: claude mcp add --transport http --scope user publora https://mcp.publora.com/mcp
Schedule a post to my LinkedIn saying "Excited to announce our new product launch!" for tomorrow at 9am EST
claims.notes: Verified on Publora's own docs. Docs list 32 tools (20 personal, 12 Agency company_* tools), including create_post/update_post/list_posts and LinkedIn reaction/comment/reshare tools. Auth via OAuth or an sk_ API key. Third-party directories give other tool counts (14, 18); the official docs number is used. Plan limits/pricing not verified.

claims.claim: LinkedIn's official API lets an approved app create posts on behalf of an authenticated member (w_member_social), via Share on LinkedIn / the Posts API.
quotes: w_member_social | Required to create a LinkedIn post on behalf of the authenticated member.
add the Share on LinkedIn product which will grant you `w_member_social`.
The Posts API replaces the ugcPosts API.
w_member_social | Post, comment, and like posts on behalf of an authenticated member.
claims.notes: Verified that member posting is an official, self-serve API product. CAVEATS: (1) The docs do NOT contain a native 'schedule' parameter; the scheduling itself happens in the third-party tool (Publora), which then publishes via the API. (2) The docs do not state in so many words that posting is 'permitted unlike messaging'; that contrast is our inference from c5 plus c6. Safe on-screen wording: 'Posting through LinkedIn's official API is allowed; automated messaging is not.' Share on LinkedIn member rate limit: 150 requests/day.

claims.claim: LinkedIn User Agreement section 8.2 prohibits using bots or other automated methods to send messages.
claims.notes: Previously verified (copied in per brief); not re-fetched in this pass.

open_questions: Apollo MCP plan/credit requirements: not stated on Apollo's README; confirm on an apollo.io page before claiming 'free'.
HubSpot's developers.hubspot.com/mcp landing page still says read-only in places, which conflicts with the 2026-04-13 GA changelog (create/update). Changelog treated as authoritative.
HubSpot tasks over MCP are blocked if the account has sensitive data turned on.
Publora pricing/plan limits for LinkedIn scheduling not verified.
